title: Drum solos: Krupa and Sid Catlett
summary: He dislikes taking solos; Krupa soloed and Sid Catlett was a great drummer working on the snare.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: different things I learned here in New York. I don't particularly like to take drum solos. But when I came to New York, that's what Gene Krupa would do, take drum solos.
Even at that time, in the late Twenties, he was taking them.
Were other drummers customarily taking drum solos? Or was Krupa pretty much the only one?
Well, Sid Catlett, he'd take some nice solos on drums. He was one of the greatest drummers I ever met.
Yeah. I mean drumming. Some of them drummers, call themselves drummers, stay on the cymbal all the time, but he'd do a lot of stuff on the snare drum.
